records.title: XRP Insights exchange balances — pre-Binance-incident daily snapshot
records.note: The October 29 08:00 UTC pre-incident snapshot totals 22.58B XRP in 701 XRPL wallets publicly attributed by XRPSCAN labels to 24 exchanges. The same-wallet change is -17.4M XRP (-0.08%) over Oct 22–29 and +35.8M (+0.18%) over Sep 29–Oct 29. Exchange balances include hot wallets, deposit hubs and cold storage, not tradable float. Binance 2.80B includes 327.4M Binance-Peg XRP reserve and 14.3M Binance US; Coinbase 5.84B includes 151.4M cbXRP reserve and 5.79B cold-labeled wallets; Bitbank 575.4M; SBI VC Trade 60.9M; Upbit 6.42B; Bithumb 1.85B; Coinone 317.7M. 488.4M tracked XRP is identified as non-customer reserves/funds: 325.8M Binance-Peg, 151.4M cbXRP, 11.2M insurance/charity. 48% of tracked XRP is cold-labeled, 14% hot-labeled and 38.4% unclassified. Twenty-two newly tracked wallets added 2.21B XRP to the naive total; same-wallet changes exclude this coverage jump. Method: daily rippled account_info on validated ledger; XRPSCAN public labels for attribution. Same-wallet change still cannot distinguish customer withdrawal from transfer to an untracked wallet. Snapshot predates the October 29 Binance incident.

records.title: TokenPost — Binance October 1 PoR reports XRP reserve ratio 100.77%
records.note: TokenPost reports Binance's October 1, 2026 PoR snapshot showed XRP reserve ratio 100.77%, alongside BTC 100.35%, ETH 100.00%, USDT 103.88%, USDC 108.26%, BNB 100.47% and SOL 100.00%. The article provides BTC and ETH balances but not the raw XRP customer-liability and on-chain reserve balances or XRP address list. This is secondary corroboration of the 100.77% figure, not an independently extracted official XRP PoR payload.

records.title: Gate News — Binance October 1 PoR asset ratios
records.note: Gate News reports, citing Binance's official October 1 PoR page, XRP reserve ratio 100.77% alongside BNB 100.47%, SOL 100.00%, BTC 100.35%, ETH 100.00%, USDT 103.88% and USDC 108.26%. It does not provide the raw XRP account-liability balance, wallet balances or five-wallet crosswalk. Secondary corroboration of the ratio only.

records.title: TokenPost — Binance XRP reserve series at September 30
records.note: TokenPost, citing CryptoQuant-derived exchange reserve data, reports Binance XRP reserves around 2.647B on September 30, down approximately 57M from September 27. This is a narrower exchange-reserve series and predates the October 1 PoR snapshot. It is not directly comparable to XRP Insights' 2.80B October 29 attributed-wallet total, which explicitly includes 327.4M Binance-Peg reserve and 14.3M Binance US.
